settings.subtitle: Four machines engineered for precision strength and Pilates training at home. Filter by series to find your match.

settings.title: Find Your Reformer
settings.text: Smart Series reformers use a 500W servo motor for 1 kg precision digital weight control - built for practitioners who want studio-grade technology at home. Mechanical Series reformers use spring resistance - foldable, lightweight, and more accessible, without compromising build quality. All Sensol reformers connect to the Vesta Sensol App for guided training across 200+ movements.
